column1: # The MAP_SHARED file writeback gate (KNOWN_ISSUES.md item 48): a store through a
# shared file mapping lands in the cache frame every mapper shares, but the file
# itself only receives it when the mapping is gone. The parent forks, the child's
# store is visible in the parent's view, and then the parent's reopen of the file
# (a fresh fd, which cannot see the cache) has to find it too. A file of its own is
# created first: a shared mapping is writable now, so this never maps an image

column2: mmapfd: shared file mapping verified: cross-process visibility and writeback
